name: supports one-pass samples and does not modify caller stacks
input: supports one-pass samples and does not modify caller stacks
test:
stack = ['main', 'work']
def samples():
    yield 0, stack
    stack.pop()
    yield 1, stack
    yield 1, []
events = stack_samples_to_trace_events(samples())
assert stack == ['main']
assert [(e['name'], e['phase'], e['timestamp']) for e in events] == [
    ('main', 'B', 0), ('work', 'B', 0), ('work', 'E', 1), ('main', 'E', 1),
]
